name: fig_concept
caption: Feature standardization improves conditioning and accelerates L-BFGS convergence
section_context: Concept diagram contrasting two pipelines on the breast-cancer dataset: raw features produce an ill-conditioned loss surface where L-BFGS needs ~1000 iterations (slow), while standardized features produce a well-conditioned surface where L-BFGS converges in ~18 iterations (fast) at equal-or-better accuracy.
